findings.evidence: W2p.lean:68 `def w2pSubmodule ... := weakDerivStepSubmodule mu Omega p W1p.gradientL`; W3p.lean:75 likewise; neither file contains a `_def` lemma. Project convention for unexposed public defs: TauCeti/RingTheory/Valuation/Continuous/Basic.lean:125-131 ("`IsContinuous` is not `@[expose]`, so a downstream module cannot unfold it ... rewriting through this lemma is the only route") and TauCeti/Topology/UniformlyLocallyConnected.lean:102-108.
findings.fix: Add public restatements `w2pSubmodule_def : w2pSubmodule mu Omega p = weakDerivStepSubmodule mu Omega p W1p.gradientL := (rfl)` and the `w3pSubmodule` analogue, or mark both defs `@[expose]` (exposure is not reducibility, so instance search is unaffected and the `inferInstanceAs` instances can stay). Optionally add the projection-level bridges `W2p.firstOrder_eq_prev`, `W2p.hessian_eq_weakFDeriv` and the `W3p` analogues as `(rfl)`.
findings.issue: `w2pSubmodule` (W2p.lean:68) and `w3pSubmodule` (W3p.lean:75) are public `def`s without `@[expose]`, and no lemma restates them. Downstream of these files `W2p mu Omega p` = `↥(w2pSubmodule ...).toSubmodule` is therefore not unifiable with `WeakDerivStep mu Omega p W1p.gradientL`, so none of the generic `WeakDerivStep` API applies to `W2p`/`W3p`, and a user holding `WeakDerivStep.prev W1p.gradientL u` still has no way to relate it to `W2p.firstOrder u`. The PR advertises the opposite (GraphStep.lean:18-20: W2p/W3p projections "are specializations of the ones proved here"), and the two `inferInstanceAs` completeness instances (W2p.lean:212, W3p.lean:241) exist only because of this same opacity.

summary: The refactor removed the duplicated step API: W2p/W3p projections, mk, ext, norm bounds and completeness are now specializations of WeakDerivStep, and the shared step gained the ext lemmas it lacked. Remaining gap: nothing publicly identifies W2p/W3p with the graph step they specialize, because w2pSubmodule/w3pSubmodule are public-but-unexposed defs with no `_def` lemma.
